card.name: The word respiratory before depression
card.fires_on: The word "respiratory" when it comes right before "depression" in opioid or sedative warnings. It often follows phrases like "risk of" or "dose-related".

modes.label: Risk of respiratory depression
modes.description: "respiratory" after "increases the risk of" in drug interaction text on opioids and benzodiazepines.
modes.example: DRUG INTERACTIONS The concomitant use of benzodiazepines and opioids increases the risk of<< respiratory>> depression because of actions at different receptor sites

modes.label: Dose-related respiratory depression
modes.description: "respiratory" after "dose-related" or "fatal" in descriptions of what an opioid produces.
modes.example: opioids, including codeine, one of the active ingredients in Promethazine HCl and Codeine Phosphate Oral Solution. Codeine produces dose-related<< respiratory>> depression by directly acting on the brain stem
